_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units、unit-texts.json 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 玉海舰队的魔法战士无人可当，没几个人能在潮汐禁卫的刀锋下全身而退。
desc.en: None can withstand the Tide Guard; few who face these magical warriors of the Jade Sea live to tell of it.

story.zh: 据说第一批潮汐禁卫的魔法与射击技艺由月后亲自传授，禁卫也因此立下只从女子中遴选的旧例。入选者多为水师中箭法出众的女兵，由禁卫统领统一锻炼长柄刀与弓的技艺。潮汐禁卫是震旦提督的贴身保镖，她们所使用的武器附着水魔法，水流缠绕其外，波涛暗藏其中。
story.en: It is said that the Moon Empress herself taught the first Tide Guard their arts of magic and marksmanship, and from that gift dates the old rule that the corps recruits only from among women. Most are the fleet's finest archers, drilled by the Guard Commander in the disciplines of the long-hafted blade and the bow. The Tide Guard are the personal bodyguard of the Cathayan admiral, and the weapons they bear are imbued with water magic: water coils about the steel, and within it sleeps the fury of the waves.

desc.zh: 水师的禁卫在阵形完整时攻守皆精
desc.en: While their formation holds, the fleet's guards excel in both attack and defence.

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 当阵列齐整时，这支部队在对抗大型部队冲锋时会无视其所有的冲锋加成
desc.en: When bracing, this unit negates the charge bonus of any large attacker.

desc.zh: 当阵列齐整时，这支部队可以对冲锋而来的敌军造成额外伤害
desc.en: When bracing, this unit causes additional damage when attacking charging enemies.

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会损失体力
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing actions, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阴
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yin unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity.
